cut: v2 (7 Nov 2026, en + fi; owner: 'The big part is that it's also in front of YLE, the BBC of Finland... Make an English and Finnish version. Also use some more 2d layers to spruce up the look. YLE aqua and white, maybe a 3rd complementing color'). The device on top of v1's found object is the TIP-OFF: the pirate station hands the public broadcaster a story found on its own doorstep. Yle is the ADDRESSEE, never the accused: the photos prove the jug was FOUND in front of Yle, not that anyone there used or left it; 'who left it: unknown' stays, and Yle has covered glyphosate for a decade (2015-2025, yle.fi), so the turn says 'you cover this; now it's on your doorstep'. Beat 2 attributes the quote to the LABEL (who markets Roundup Piha in Finland is not verified, so no company is named on screen). Cut-paper layers over the photos in Yle's aqua (#03b1d1, measured off the sign in photo 1), white paper, and the RFH gold (#f2b83a) as the one warm complement, which is also the pop colour, so the layers and the words agree. The Yle logo is never redrawn: it appears only as photographed. v1 (7 Nov, en only) is kept as films/07-11-Helsinki1-Found-in-Pasila-v1.mp4. US spelling. Finnish written by the assistant, native read pending; the last Finnish line is the owner's own (7 Nov): 'YLE: Tuttu aihe. Nyt ihan omalla pihallanne.'
argument: A Roundup jug found in front of Yle in Pasila, where any kid could pick it up: who left it is unknown, the EU allows glyphosate until 2033, and Yle's own story is on its doorstep.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word

captions.source: The owner's own photos, Sat 7 Nov 2026 morning: a 5 L Roundup Piha jug in a flowerbed by the Yle campus signpost (Mediatalo / Luova talo / Studiotalo), Pasila, the Yle sign behind it. 'In front of' is all the photos prove; the copy never says used, Yle's, or the city's.

text.en: 'Kills weeds, / roots and all,' / says the [label].

captions.source: The label in the photos (Finnish): 'Hävittää rikkakasvit juurineen' = kills weeds, roots and all; also 'Tehoaa jopa vuorokaudessa', 'Näkyviä tuloksia 24 tunnissa'. Attributed to the LABEL, not to a company: Bayer owns the Roundup brand, but who markets the Roundup Piha consumer line in Finland is not verified (the European consumer line has been handled by licensees). Roundup Piha is sold to consumers in Finland (MTV 2019). Search summaries only.

text.en: Left where / any kid could / [pick it up].

captions.source: What the photos show: the jug at ground level in a public flowerbed by the path and the tram stop, among leaves, within a small child's reach. Not known from the photos: who left it, whether it is empty, whether anything was sprayed there, or whose land the bed is. Nothing is attached to Yle, the City of Helsinki or any contractor.

text.en: The EU allows it / until 2033. / Cancer? IARC: / [probably].
text.fi: EU sallii sen / vuoteen 2033. / Syöpä? IARC: / [todennäköisesti].

captions.source: EU renewal: the Commission renewed glyphosate's approval for ten years after member states deadlocked; the implementing regulation was published 29 Nov 2023 and runs to 15 Dec 2033; pre-harvest desiccation is banned, pre-harvest weed control stays allowed; member states may restrict nationally (NFU, Agriland, Farmers Weekly, Phys.org/AFP). IARC 2015: 'probably carcinogenic to humans' (2A). ECHA's Committee for Risk Assessment, opinion adopted 30 May 2022: the evidence did not meet the criteria to classify glyphosate as carcinogenic (NGOs disputed it). EPA and EFSA did not find it likely carcinogenic. Bayer says it is safe. The science is attributed both ways on screen. All from search summaries.

text.en: Dear Yle: / you cover this. / Now it's on / your [doorstep].
text.fi: YLE: Tuttu aihe. / Nyt ihan omalla / [pihallanne].

captions.source: Yle has covered glyphosate repeatedly (yle.fi, from search summaries): 2015 'Torjunta-aineesta on tullut syöpäriski'; 2016 Tukes banning POEA products (yle.fi/a/3-8741000); 2017 the EU extension (yle.fi/a/3-9950495); 2018 the Johnson verdict (yle.fi/a/3-10348209); 2019 'Huoli Suomen yleisimmän rikkakasvimyrkyn glyfosaatin turvallisuudesta kasvaa' (yle.fi/a/3-10702830); 2023 a microbes study (yle.fi/a/74-20026360); 2024-25 a bumblebee study (yle.fi/a/74-20165372) and a US rural-births study (yle.fi/a/74-20138908); plus an Areena piece 'Myrkkyä pelloille?'. So the turn hands Yle a story it knows, found on its own doorstep; it does not say Yle ignored the topic, used the product or left it. City of Helsinki: answering council initiative HEL 2020-000554 (Marcus Rantala + 18), the city board said its goal is already to stop using glyphosate-based products in the parks and other built areas it owns; the council closed the matter 7 Oct 2020 (paatokset.hel.fi; search summary). The bed may not be city land: the tag states the goal, not a breach. Finnish last line is the owner's own (7 Nov): 'YLE: Tuttu aihe. Nyt ihan omalla pihallanne.'

post.en: Found this morning in a flowerbed in front of Yle, Pasila: a 5 L Roundup jug, where any kid could pick it up. Who left it: unknown. The EU allows glyphosate until 2033; IARC says 'probably' carcinogenic, ECHA and Bayer disagree. Yle has covered this for years. Your doorstep now?
post.fi: Löytyi kukkapenkistä Ylen edestä Pasilasta: 5 litran Roundup-kanisteri, lasten ulottuvilla. Kuka jätti: ei tiedetä. EU sallii glyfosaatin vuoteen 2033; IARC: todennäköisesti syöpävaarallinen; ECHA, Bayer: eri mieltä. Yle on kertonut aiheesta vuosia. Nyt ihan omalla pihallanne?
